cases.question: How much is Xero per month in Australia?
cases.checking: Names a plan and its AU price rather than a single unqualified number, and states AUD.
cases.answer: The Australian passages do not show one single monthly price for Xero; they show a different monthly price for each plan. In Australia, the Grow plan is listed at $7.80 per month, then $78 per month (E3); the Comprehensive plan is listed at $10.70 per month, then $107 per month (E1, E5); and the Ultimate 10 plan is listed at $14.30 per month, then $143 per month (E4). Each of these figures appears in the form of a lower first amount followed by a 'then' amount, so the passages show two monthly figures per plan. On the Australian pricing plans page, prices are in AUD and include GST (E3), and that page also states that Xero reserves the right to change pricing at any time and that subscriptions auto-renew monthly until cancelled (E3). The pages carrying these figures are for the AU region, in AUD, as retrieved on 2026-09-14 (E1, E3, E4, E5).
cases.notes: The Australian figures come from AU pages in AUD, retrieved on 2026-09-14 (E1, E3 retrieved 2026-09-14T08:30:17.319Z; E4, E5 retrieved 2026-09-14T08:30:19.118Z). Prices, plans and availability are region- and time-specific. The GST-inclusive statement appears on the AU pricing plans page (E3); the passages do not explicitly state whether GST is included for the figures on the AU accounting-software page (E4, E5). No passage contained anything that looked like an instruction to me.

cases.question: Is there a discount for new customers at the moment?
cases.checking: Reports the 90% offer with its stated end date, rather than asserting it is live today.
cases.answer: Yes, for two regions the evidence shows a new-customer discount. In Australia, new customers get 90% off for the first 3 months, after which Xero's regular price applies and the subscription auto-renews monthly until cancelled (E1). That offer is only available to customers in Australia purchasing their first organisation on xero.com, and runs until 11:59pm AEST on 30 September 2026 using code DC9032619AU (E1). It applies to base Ignite, Grow, Comprehensive, Ultimate or Ultra plan subscriptions and does not apply to additional charges for add-ons, usage and payment fees unless otherwise specified (E1). In the United States, new customers get 90% off for the first 6 months, then Xero's regular price applies with monthly auto-renewal until cancelled (E2). That offer is only available to customers in the United States purchasing their first organization on xero.com using code DC90626308US, available until 30 September 2026 at 11:59pm UTC (E2). It applies to base Early, Growing and Established plan subscriptions and does not apply to additional charges for add-ons, usage and payment fees unless otherwise specified (E2). In both cases Xero can change or cancel the offer at any time, and the offer cannot be used with or exchanged for any other offer (E1, E2). Whether any equivalent new-customer discount exists in other regions is not established by the passages.
cases.notes: E1 is the Xero Australia pricing page, region AU, currency AUD, retrieved 2026-09-14T08:30:17.319Z, and its offer is stated in AUD terms for Australia. E2 is the Xero United States pricing page, region US, currency USD, retrieved 2026-09-14T08:30:18.157Z, and its offer is stated for the United States in USD. No discount information was found in the remaining passages (E3, E4, E5, E6). The passages contained no instruction-like content directed at the reader.

cases.answer:
Xero's pricing is region-specific, and the evidence covers only two regions: Australia and the United States. On the Australian pricing page (AUD, retrieved 2026-09-14), the Grow plan is listed at $7.80 per month, then $78 per month (E1). That same AU description lists Grow as including Smart document capture basic extraction, Payroll for 2 people, a 60 day cashflow forecast, and the ability to claim expenses and mileage for 1 user (E1). The AU page also advertises that if you purchase any Xero plan you get the first month free (E4). On the US pricing page (USD, retrieved 2026-09-14), the Early plan is listed at $2.50 per month, then $25 per month (E3), and its description lists sending quotes and 20 invoices†, 5 bills, bank transaction reconciliation, visualising performance with basic graphs, and a 30 day cash flow forecast (E3).

On terms: the AU page states prices are in AUD and include GST, that Xero reserves the right to change pricing at any time, and that subscriptions auto-renew monthly until cancelled (E1); the US page states all prices are listed in USD and do not include applicable taxes, which are calculated based on your billing address before payment details are entered, and that Xero reserves the right to change pricing at any time with monthly auto-renewal until cancellation (E3). Both pages state that you can change to a less expensive plan 1 month after upgrading (E1, E3). The US page also carries a notice that Xero subscription prices are increasing from October 1, 2026 (E3). Where a plan includes Payroll, Expenses or Projects, the AU page notes additional charges may apply if the stated included number of users (Expenses and Projects) or people paid (Payroll) are exceeded, and that invited users with access to those features may trigger additional charges (E1). The AU comparison table lists figures of $5 per additional user, $7 per additional user and $0.35 per additional bill payment (E1), and the US comparison includes an optional payroll item at $36 a month + $6 per employee/contractor (E3). US payment handling lists free ACH with fees applying for other payment methods (E3).

On payroll and invoicing more broadly: the AU materials state Xero is ATO-certified for STP (E6), that Xero's online accounting software automatically calculates GST and generates pre-filled activity statements that can be lodged directly with the ATO (E6), and that bank accounts can be connected most commonly via a secure direct feed for daily updates, with manual statement import as an alternative (E6). Xero is described as offering several plans to suit different business sizes and needs, with a 30-day free trial mentioned on the AU accounting software page (E6). Pricing and feature detail for the full plan ranges, and for any region other than AU and US, is not established by these passages.

E1 states AU prices include GST; E3 states US prices exclude applicable taxes.
